title: Email agent
subtitle: Looks at new mail and upcoming events and acts on your rules.
off: The agent is off. Turn it on and it will look at the mail that arrives from then on.

rules.title: Agent rules
rules.subtitle: Each rule pairs a prompt that picks the emails or events with a prompt that says what to do.
rules.empty: No rules yet. A rule says which emails or events the agent acts on and what it does.
rules.name: Name
rules.triggerEvent: An event is about to start
rules.matchPlaceholder: e.g. A customer reports a problem or asks for help with the product
rules.actionPlaceholder: e.g. Draft a friendly reply asking for a screenshot, and create a task to follow up
rules.alwaysApproveHint: Archiving, starring and marking as read always wait for your approval. Drafts stay local until you open them. The agent never sends email.

panels.title: Stats panel
panels.name: Title
panels.hint: The agent counts the inbox emails this prompt describes. Mail already in the period is counted in the background.

feed.empty: Nothing yet. When an email or event matches one of your rules, the agent tells you here what it found and what it did.
feed.failed: The agent could not finish with this one.
